author: JOHN_CENAAAAAAAA
body:
This is a more constructive continuation of the "Avicus is going Downhill"  thread.  It's appreciated that constructive, as opposed to destructive criticism is used.  Because let's face it, according to sources, MCZone had 1500+ minimum on average.  Now we're lucky to get 600 members on a good day.  Avicus is going downhill, clearly, and we're going to have to point out the problem.  Many know what I think it is, so I'm not going to list it in this message here.  If you need proof, here's the current amount of players on Avicus.  

http://gyazo.com/b79118b4b95c37328fcae36ab954f804

So please list your ideas on why you think the server is going downhill, or why you think it isn't.

And FYI, it's appreciated if a Mod allows us to actually discuss instead of closing the thread within ten minutes.

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Ok. Let me just say something. Don't you think it's not fair to say that the player count is going down just because people you know are leaving. With every person leaving another 100 players come in. People leave. That's the way it works. You most likely won't like Minecraft your ENTIRE life. Most people that left got around the age where they need to focus on college or work. Also, why does everything have to be the staff's fault? Why is it always  Players vs. Staff? Staff are players too. On another note, most staff resigned. Only about 2 actually got demoted recently. From what I've seen, the new Jr. Mods are working as hard as they can right now, and are doing an amazing job. Instead of making them feel bad for working hard, why not encourage them to become great mods one day? Also, as for the player count right now, a lot of players are in the EST time zone. In EST right now it's 1 AM. Not many people would be playing at 1 AM.

replies.body:
I decided not to take the time to read this entire post.
But I will however give my opinion on the situation.
People are saying 'another great moderator goes down' and all this.
You dont know what happens behind the scenes, and you dont deserve to know either.
Everything that happens, happens for a reason. 

Many of you are complaining that avicus is going downhill and that things are absolute shit. Well let me tell you something, lets say you take a player, 'jonboy2020'. He is a very active player and loves nebula. He always finds a few full games and enjoys it.
He sees absolutely no issue with avicus as it is.
There is no problem, All problems that have ever arisen are due to events that we have created.
There are several ways to solve said problems, one simple way is to stop TREATING it as a problem, and treat it as a new OPPORTUNITY . Once we do that, we can not only find a solution much much quicker, but also find better solutions.
I have taken to task finding moderately cheap ways to advertise.
Mainly paying a certain amount each day to have our server placed at the top of the minecraft server lists.
I think if we actually stop treating this as a life/death situation, we can find a solution much quicker.
Im going to do my best to find ways to increase our player base, youtubers are not going to help as we have seen in the past.
Contact me on skype if you find any good ways to advertise which are in a reasonable price range.
